SV Bible quote.summary: Quotes a Bible passage through BibleGet, in the wiki's default version. Use it for every verse an article names or alludes to.

params.ref: (required) the reference, book names in the wiki's language (Jn 3:16, Gv 3,16, Jean 3,16)
params.version: a BibleGet version code; defaults to the wiki's version
params.inline: 0 = show the passage as a block instead of a hover quote

SV WIP.summary: Marks an article as a work in progress (adds a maintenance category).

SV bio.summary: The opening sentence of a biography, written from the page's Wikibase item in the wiki's language: name, birth and death places and dates, occupation and nationality agreeing with the person's sex or gender. Adds no categories; missing facts are left out.

params.item: a Wikibase item ID to use instead of the page's own item (needed when the page is not connected to one)
params.name: the name to show instead of the item's label (e.g. a fuller form)
params.note: free text after the name, e.g. "pseudonimo di Filippo Neviani"
params.rest: free text continuing the sentence after the occupation (starts with a comma or a word)
params.ref: references, appended verbatim at the end

SV categories.summary: Files the page under its Wikibase item's SV field and SV Gospel theme categories, in the wiki's language. Use it on pages without an SV infobox; every SV infobox outputs the same categories.

params.item: a Wikibase item ID to use instead of the page's own item (needed when the page is not connected to one)
params.sortkey: sort key for the categories (e.g. the title without its article)

SV category tree.summary: The main page's category navigation (fields, then Gospel themes) from config/categories.json. No parameters.

SV cathopedia.summary: A link to an Italian Cathopedia page; on non-Italian wikis adds '(in Italian)'. Use under See also / External links outside it.wiki.

params.1: (required) the Cathopedia page title, in Italian
params.2: link text in the wiki's language; defaults to the title

SV cite.summary: A citation (web page, book, journal, video, album liner notes, interview) with fixed parameter names and localized labels.

params.type: web (default), book, journal, video, liner, interview
params.title: (required)

SV discernment.summary: Starts the closing section on how the work relates to the Gospel, with the same heading on every wiki. On its own line.

SV infobox.summary: The SeminaVerbi infobox: layout from the item's instance of, rows from its statements, categories from its SV field / SV Gospel theme. Write just {{SV infobox}}; any row key overrides the item's value.

params.type: layout when the item's type is missing or ambiguous: book, film, tv, album, song, play, artwork, person, group, work
params.item: a Wikibase item ID to use instead of the page's own item (needed when the page is not connected to one)
params.name: caption; defaults to the item's label
params.sortkey: sort key for the item's categories

SV infobox person.summary: Infobox for a person, filled from the page's Wikibase item. Any field (see below) overrides the item's value.

params.item: a Wikibase item ID to use instead of the page's own item (needed when the page is not connected to one)
params.name: caption; defaults to the item's label
params.sortkey: sort key for the item's categories

SV infobox work.summary: Infobox for a work, filled from the page's Wikibase item. Any field of its type (see below) overrides the item's value.

params.type: book (default), film, tv, album, song, play, artwork
params.item: a Wikibase item ID to use instead of the page's own item (needed when the page is not connected to one)
params.name: caption; defaults to the item's label
params.sortkey: sort key for the item's categories

SV quote.summary: A quotation that is not from the Bible, optionally with its original-language text above the translation.

params.text: (required) the quotation in the wiki's language; wikitext allowed
params.author: may be a link
params.source: the work or document; may be a link
params.original: the quotation in its original language
params.original_lang: language code of original (it, la, grc…)
params.text_lang: language code of text when it is not the wiki's language (omitted: the wiki's language); with original, each version is labelled below with its language, named in the wiki's language, when that name is known (no label for a missing, malformed or unknown code)

SV references.summary: The references heading and list. On its own line, near the end of the article.
